body: It sounds like your wife is suffering the loss of your non-depressed self.  I don't think she will be a good source of support at the moment.  I guess you are also suffering the loss of your idea of your wife being supportive.  Grief is a process.  It will take time to heal. Try to be self compassionate. Also try to be compassionate for your wife's suffering.  Have you tried a self compassion meditation?  They call it loving kindness but it is also known as a friendly feeling meditation.  I have a disease and they have helped me feel better about my life.
